description.en: It gets into a place where too many sleep too close, and it does not leave until it has been through everybody.
description.cs: Uchytí se tam, kde spí moc lidí moc blízko u sebe, a neodejde, dokud si neprojde všechny.

description.en: Bad water, and a colony that drew it from one place.
description.cs: Špatná voda — a osada, co ji brala z jednoho místa.

description.en: It starts in one house and is in the next street by the time anyone says the word.
description.cs: Začne v jednom domě a než to někdo pojmenuje, je o ulici dál.

description.en: The one every chronicle has a chapter for. It does not care how many spears you own.
description.cs: Ta, na kterou má každá kronika kapitolu. Je jí jedno, kolik máš kopí.

description.en: Not caught from anybody — breathed in, day after day, in a shed nobody opens a window in.
description.cs: Nechytíš to od nikoho — vdechuješ to den za dnem v hale, kde nikdo neotevře okno.
